answer: Your offer likely has not expired. Offers issued before February 1, 2026 keep their original terms of 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, so the 5-day limit doesn't apply to your January 28 offer. We honor the offer if your appraisal appointment is on or before the expiration date, so please confirm that date on your offer page or in your confirmation email and make sure you haven't driven more than 300 additional miles.
